scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana
description:
The Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in India. 

This scheme was officially launched on 1st November 2021. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to the families of cattle herders and dairy farmers in the state. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to enhance the livelihood of those engaged in cattle rearing and dairy farming. 

The government aims to provide support to approximately 1.5 lakh families under this initiative. 

The scheme specifically targets those who are involved in the rearing of cattle for milk production. 

It also focuses on improving the economic conditions of the families dependent on dairy farming. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is aimed at reducing the economic burden on these families. 

Each eligible family can receive a financial assistance of INR 10,000 per year. 

This amount is intended to support the purchase of fodder and other essential resources for cattle. 

The scheme also aims to promote better animal husbandry practices among the beneficiaries. 

The government has set a target of increasing the milk production in the state by 20 percent over the next five years. 

The Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana is part of a broader initiative to boost the dairy sector in Madhya Pradesh. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are clearly defined. 

Beneficiaries must be residents of Madhya Pradesh. 

They must belong to families involved in dairy farming or cattle rearing. 

The scheme is primarily aimed at small and marginal farmers. 

The income limit for eligibility is set at INR 2 lakh per annum. 

Applicants must possess at least two milch animals to qualify for the assistance. 

The application process is straightforward and designed to be user-friendly. 

Interested beneficiaries must visit the nearest Janpad Panchayat office to apply. 

They need to fill out the application form available at the office. 

The required documents include proof of residence, income certificate, and details of the milch animals owned. 

Once the application is submitted, it is verified by the concerned authorities. 

The disbursement of the financial assistance is done directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries. 

The government aims to complete the verification process within 30 days of application submission. 

The financial assistance is disbursed annually. 

The first installment is expected to be released within three months of the application approval. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Madhya Pradesh. 

The department is responsible for the overall management and execution of the scheme. 

For any queries or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the department at their official helpline number. 

The helpline number is available on the official government website. 

The scheme is expected to significantly impact the livelihood of dairy farmers in the state. 

By providing financial assistance, the government aims to reduce poverty levels among these communities. 

The scheme also encourages sustainable practices in dairy farming. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 150 crore for the implementation of this scheme in the financial year 2021-2022. 

This budget is expected to cover the assistance for approximately 1.5 lakh families. 

The scheme is part of the Madhya Pradesh government's commitment to improving the agricultural and rural economy. 

The Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana is aligned with the national goal of increasing milk production in India. 

India is the largest producer of milk in the world, contributing to about 22 percent of global milk production. 

The dairy sector plays a crucial role in the rural economy of Madhya Pradesh. 

It provides employment to millions of people in the state. 

The government is also promoting cooperative societies to enhance the dairy business. 

These cooperatives help in better marketing and distribution of milk and dairy products. 

The Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana is expected to empower women as well. 

Women are often the primary caretakers of livestock in rural areas. 

By supporting dairy farming, the scheme indirectly promotes women's economic independence. 

The government is also planning to conduct training programs for beneficiaries. 

These programs will focus on modern dairy farming techniques and animal health management. 

The training is aimed at increasing productivity and ensuring better animal welfare. 

The scheme is expected to create a ripple effect in the rural economy. 

Increased milk production will lead to more job opportunities in related sectors. 

The government is monitoring the implementation of the scheme closely. 

Regular assessments will be conducted to evaluate its impact on the beneficiaries. 

Feedback from the beneficiaries will also be taken into account for future improvements. 

The Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana represents a significant step towards supporting the dairy sector in Madhya Pradesh. 

It reflects the government's commitment to enhancing the livelihoods of rural families. 

The scheme is expected to bring about positive changes in the socio-economic conditions of dairy farmers in the state. 

Overall, this initiative is a vital part of the Madhya Pradesh government's strategy to uplift the agricultural sector. 

The Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana is a comprehensive approach to addressing the challenges faced by dairy farmers. 

It provides tangible benefits that can lead to sustainable development in the region.
